issues.description: The point at the end of segment PD on the circle (point_06, [360.31,122.15]) is bound to the letter O. The original prints D beside that endpoint, and O appears only at the centre below AB (point_02). The rendered TikZ is correct (D is drawn there), so this is a binding error in the point metadata, not a drawing error.
issues.suggestion: Rebind point_06 to D, or drop the O binding on point_06 and bind D to it. Keep O bound to point_02 only.
